description: This file defines a PHP class 'Style' used for handling style-related writing of cell, row, column, and table styles in an OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) file within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for mapping alignments, writing style attributes, and handling style elements in the XML structure.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: A helper class responsible for writing style elements for cells, rows, columns, and tables in an ODS spreadsheet document by generating corresponding XML elements and attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Style object with an XMLWriter instance for XML output.

methods.name: mapHorizontalAlignment
methods.description: Converts horizontal alignment constants to corresponding XML attribute values.

methods.name: mapVerticalAlignment
methods.description: Converts vertical alignment constants to corresponding XML attribute values.

methods.name: writeFillStyle
methods.description: Writes background fill styles to XML based on fill type.

methods.name: writeCellProperties
methods.description: Writes cell-specific style properties such as alignment and fill.

methods.name: mapUnderlineStyle
methods.description: Maps font underline styles to their string representations.

methods.name: writeTextProperties
methods.description: Writes font and text styling properties to XML.

methods.name: writeColumnProperties
methods.description: Writes column width and related properties.

methods.name: writeColumnStyles
methods.description: Creates and writes a style element for a column dimension.

methods.name: writeRowProperties
methods.description: Writes row height and other row-specific properties.

methods.name: writeRowStyles
methods.description: Creates and writes a style element for a row dimension.

methods.name: writeTableStyle
methods.description: Creates and writes style settings for a worksheet table.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a complete style element for a given cell style.
